name: Furry Adventure!
summary:
Furry Adventure is a relaxing puzzle game that invites you into a charming fantasy world filled with beautiful furry heroines, pleasant music, colorful illustrations, and Steam achievements.

Complete puzzles, unlock new images, and enjoy a calm atmosphere designed for players who love cute fantasy characters, simple gameplay, and beautiful visual rewards. The game is easy to understand, relaxing to play, and perfect for short casual sessions.
